required_checks.proves: Nuxt 3 and Vue 3 Composition API replace the production Next.js and React runtime
A clean checkout installs reproducibly and passes build, type-check, and lint
Telnyx credentials stay server-side and all server routes validate and map upstream behavior
The Telnyx Video SDK boundary is typed, testable, lifecycle-safe, and behaviorally complete
Room discovery, join, meeting, media, participant, chat, presentation, invite, diagnostics, metrics, and reconnect workflows remain supported
Unit, component, server-route, and browser smoke suites pass without live Telnyx credentials
Representative desktop and narrow viewport screens are usable and visually reviewed
SDK listeners, timers, streams, tracks, and generated media resources are disposed deterministically
No credential-bearing local or generated files are tracked or emitted as evidence
Only the fork's vue-fastvm-benchmark branch is mutated
Architecture, parity, security, build, test, and migration documentation is complete

hidden_suite.rule: The same sealed suite and digest must be used for the AFK baseline and Hive run.
